title: The Levites as a Substitute for the Firstborn
description: The Lord commands Moses to number the Levites and give them to Aaron as servants at the tabernacle, in place of all the firstborn boys in Israel. The chapter describes the division of the Levitical clans, their duties at the sanctuary, and the calculation of redemption prices for those firstborn who exceed the number of Levites [ref:Num 3:1-51|Numbers 3:1-51].
